title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned NOC Status Mosaic for the Pertisk fleet shell. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: NOC Status Mosaic
options.thesis: The fleet reads as one quiet NOC wall: every cluster a status cell on a shared lattice.
options.viewport: Sidebar + fleet title; stats as thin mosaic strip; full-width cluster lattice with online/offline LEDs; activity as lasting marks below.
options.risk: Can densify into dashboard noise if cells become cards.

raised.raise: Shared measurement grid — every fleet column locks to one lattice.
Rank by luminance and type weight, not card chrome.
Chrome collapse propagates as one linked fold.
Every status has a named text cue, never color alone.

options.label: Commissioning Punch List
options.thesis: Fleet ops as a clean punch list: sections, checkmarks, zero ornamental chrome.
options.viewport: Pertisk KOS brand; Fleet overview as sectioned checklist of clusters with online checks; New cluster as primary check action.
options.risk: Also the direction most clean-infra runs land on — familiar by design.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.thesis: Clusters as glass slides on one rack: one type size, rank by weight and reversal.
options.viewport: Lateral rack of cluster slides; codes and versions in one size; active cluster as reversed plate.
options.case: Holds product clarity for tabular fleet truth; weaker audience ID than a NOC for private-cloud operators.
options.risk: Warm goldenrod can drift into the cream-default AI look if not kept cool-slate.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.thesis: Fleet metrics as phosphor traces on a shared graticule.
options.viewport: One graticule screen; cluster channels overlay as traces.
options.case: Loses audience ID (lab bench ≠ day-job fleet) and clarity for status rows.

options.label: Void Queue
options.thesis: Work floats on emissive void; rank is depth, never boxes.
options.viewport: Ivory fleet lines on black; amber caret on the active row.
options.case: Fails audience ID and conflicts with clean/minimal anti-neon brief.
options.kept: Rank by luminance and weight without card chrome.

options.label: Miura Deploy Sheet
options.thesis: One pull deploys the linked fleet field.
options.viewport: Compact packet opens into tessellated cluster field.
options.case: Weak audience ID; fold metaphor muddies status scanning.
options.kept: One control propagates linked collapse across chrome.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.thesis: Atmosphere bands carry fleet phase from night to day.
options.viewport: Horizon-stacked fleet phases with named cues.
options.case: Fails audience ID; color-led state weakens status truth.
options.kept: Named cue states with text equivalents.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean modern infrastructure console executed at full craft — the expected fleet dashboard.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, stat cards, cluster table, right rail — competitor-shaped.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other cloud consoles by design.
